question: Should compute/sentry be related duplicate_of dev-services/sentry-open-source, and compute/datadog duplicate_of dev-services/datadog-open-source? A discover unit added the two open source programmes to dev-services, from the same first-party pages that the two compute records cite.
why: A record never moves topic.
